# nexus-ai-pro

> The typed AI framework for TypeScript. One API for provider routing and failover, agent graphs and workflows that run branches in parallel and survive a restart, retrieval over any vector store, MCP, durable background operations, guardrails, cost control, images, voice, and evals — with a studio a team can share.

Import only what you use. The root import is the client and nothing else, and every other capability has its own entry point with a size budget CI enforces; [the packaging guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/packaging.md) publishes what each one costs. The package has no required dependencies: a graph-only application loads 78 KB, and installs nothing but this package.

- Install with `npm install nexus-ai-pro`. It needs Node.js 22 or newer, and ships ESM and CommonJS builds with shared types. License: MIT.
- It has 145 entry points. `nexus-ai-pro` itself is the client, and every other capability has its own subpath, such as `nexus-ai-pro/graph`.
- Nothing is a required dependency. Install only the optional peers you use: `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `@types/node`, `ajv`, `ajv-formats`, `ollama`, `openai`, `zod`.
- Each guide explains every export of its entry points, then lists them in a reference generated from the doc comments.

## Guides

- [The client](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/core.md): Requests, context windows, token optimization, cost checks, reasoning, prompt caching, streaming
- [The lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/lifecycle.md): Authorization, a shared budget, hooks, audit, and metrics for every call of every family
- [Providers and routing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/providers.md): The twelve completion providers, routing and failover, the model registry
- [Guardrails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/security.md): Injection, PII, secrets, schema validation, output redaction
- [Graphs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/graphs.md): Parallel branches, interrupts, checkpoints, time travel, subgraphs, caching, diagrams
- [Agents and tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/agents.md): Graph-based agents with approvals and middleware, and the simple tool loop
- [Long-term memory](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/memory.md): Namespaced memory with semantic search, in memory or Redis
- [MCP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/mcp.md): Borrowing tools from MCP servers, a registry of many, and serving your own
- [Traces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/tracing.md): Run trees, queries, feedback, comparison, and alerts
- [Evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/evaluation.md): Datasets, evaluators, experiments, comparisons with a verdict, review queues, LLM judges
- [Context hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/context-hub.md): Prompts, instructions, tools, and skills versioned together, promoted through gates, and moved between projects
- [Insights](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/insights.md): Failing and slow runs clustered, regressions between time windows, and evaluated fix proposals
- [Prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/prompts.md): Typed templates, content versions, gated promotion, rollback, A/B splits, serving through outages
- [Postgres](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/postgres.md): One adapter family for operations, memory, traces, evaluation, circuits, and prompts
- [SQLite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/sqlite.md): Durable operations, checkpoints, and memory on one machine, over any SQLite driver
- [Durable operations and jobs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/operations.md): Operations that survive a restart, webhooks, and in-process job helpers
- [Resilience and observability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/resilience.md): Circuit breaking, distributed rate limits, metrics, logs, and audit
- [Batch tiers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/batch.md): The providers' discounted batch APIs, resumable from any process
- [Caching](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/caching.md): Exact and semantic response caches, with memory, Redis, and SQLite adapters
- [Grounding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/grounding.md): Retrieval, citations, verification, self-consistency, and knowledge graphs
- [Loaders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/loaders.md): Files, Markdown, HTML, CSV, JSON, PDF, web pages, sitemaps, and Git repositories into retrieval
- [Retrieval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/retrieval.md): Hybrid search, reranking, MMR, parent documents, and Redis, Pinecone, Weaviate, and Chroma stores
- [Embeddings and retrieval](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/embeddings.md): Embeddings as a routed operation family, and RAG helpers
- [Images (experimental)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/images.md): Generation and masked edits over three backends, input safety, moderation, asset stores
- [Voice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/voice.md): Transcription, speech, voice turns, and voice sessions
- [Realtime voice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/realtime.md): Browser and server realtime sessions with barge-in, tools, and exports
- [Telephony](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/telephony.md): Calls, webhooks, phone numbers, and phone agents on realtime sessions
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/testing.md): Recording and replaying provider traffic, and conformance suites
- [Studio](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/studio.md): A shared UI for traces, threads, approvals, experiments, prompts, deployments, costs, and health, as a separate package
- [Agent server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/server.md): Self-hosted HTTP server for assistants: threads, durable runs, resumable streams, cron, a worker queue, and metrics
- [Deployments](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/deployments.md): Revisions and canaries with automatic rollback, autoscaling on Kubernetes and Helm, and per-tenant limits
- [Tenancy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/tenancy.md): One tenant model: a tenant's view of every store, tenant graph runs, and the isolation suite
- [Workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/workflows.md): Ready-made chains and domain workflows
- [Command line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/cli.md): The `nexus` command
- [Packaging and install weight](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkhitar-abrahamyan/nexus-ai/main/docs/packaging.md): Every entry point and what it costs
